conditional_exclusions: DSA indexer tensors are not touched while visible context is <=2048; nextn tensors are outside the committed runner

residency_candidate_legend.conditional_requires_measurement: measure a representative boundary before residency
residency_candidate_legend.hot_subset_candidate: measured repeated boundary; requires residency experiment
residency_candidate_legend.not_exercised: not exercised by the frozen short-context run
residency_candidate_legend.row_access_only: embedding row lookup does not justify full decode from catalog arithmetic

scope: all catalog tensors excluding routed and shared expert matrices
touch_contract: one logical short-context use per processed token for exercised tensors; output/head use selects the next token, and the terminal stack has no later logits use
